title: Vampire Vape Koncept Pinkman E-Liquid Short Fill 50ml
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman is an iconic name in the vaping world, celebrated for its vibrant and multi-layered fruit composition. This 50ml Koncept Shortfill edition brings the legendary recipe to high-performance setups, anchored by a deep foundation of sweet Red Berries. On the inhale, the juicy notes of Strawberry and Raspberry provide a naturally sweet and consistent fruit base. The profile is defined by the signature hints of zesty Citrus and Tropical Fruit that have made Pinkman a global favourite. These subtle, tangy undertones balance the sweetness of the berries to ensure the flavour remains refreshing and complex. It is a well-rounded fruit blend that avoids becoming overly sugary, making it a reliable choice for an all-day sub-ohm vape. Part of the Vampire Vape Koncept range, this 50ml e-liquid is formulated with a 70VG/30PG ratio. This higher vegetable glycerin content is specifically designed for use with high-powered sub-ohm kits and tanks using low-resistance coils, producing dense vapour and a smooth throat hit. The e-liquid is supplied in a 60ml bottle, leaving 10ml of space for you to add a nicotine shot and customise the strength to your preference. For example, adding one 10ml, 18mg nicotine shot will create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. This format offers a more sustainable and cost-effective way to enjoy one of the most famous creations from the Vampire Vape labs in a high-performance format.
